title: mattstack bindings manifest (.mattstack/skills.jsonc)
description: Consumer-repo manifest: enabled stack skills, per-work-type pipelines, and slot bindings for parameterized skills. JSONC: JSON plus full-line // comments; no trailing commas.

version.description: Manifest format version. This schema describes version 1.

enabled.description: Stack skills this repo uses. Declarative record in phase 1; not read by resolve-args.sh.

pipelines.description: Per-work-type pipelines (work type -> ordered stage skills). Schema-complete in phase 1; consumed by the orchestrator in a later phase.

additionalProperties.description: Slot name -> inner skill name, for one wrapper skill.

bindings.description: Wrapper skill name -> slot bindings. The only section resolve-args.sh reads.
